headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 15 at 2:04PM PST until November 18 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Diego CA
description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 6 to 9 feet with sets to 11 feet
along west-facing beaches and very strong rip currents.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...While surf gradually wanes today into
Monday, it will still remain elevated (4-7 feet). A fresh swell
arrives Monday afternoon, ramping the surf heights back up to 6
to 9 feet, with sets to 10 to 11 feet along west-facing beaches.
